title: Confirmation callbacks are missing
briefing: Some payment confirmations are late. Decide whether the current evidence supports a specific diagnostic.

actions.label: Inspect provider callback delivery status
actions.criteria: Use when evidence includes a provider delivery failure or an affected provider transaction ID.
actions.instructions: Compare provider delivery attempts with the affected payment confirmation IDs.

actions.label: Inspect the callback receiver
actions.criteria: Use when inbound receiver logs indicate authentication failures or rejected callback requests.
actions.instructions: Compare receiver responses and authentication checks for the affected callbacks.

actions.label: Inspect callback processing lag
actions.criteria: Use when callbacks reached the receiver but remain unprocessed.
actions.instructions: Compare receipt timestamps with processing checkpoints for the affected callbacks.

fallback: Collect the provider transaction ID and the corresponding callback receipt or delivery attempt timestamp.

events.text: Some payment confirmation views remain pending after two minutes. The aggregate sample has no transaction IDs.
Provider status page is healthy. It reports checkout authorizations and has no callback delivery metrics.
Callback receiver telemetry is delayed by 20 minutes and no sample from the affected window has arrived. A dashboard currently shows counts from before 05:00 UTC.

debrief.summary: The replay stopped before correlated callback data became available. A green authorization status and older receiver counts left the competing hypotheses open.
lessons: Check the measurement scope and sampling window before relying on a green indicator.
Use a correlated payment ID to connect callback delivery, receipt, and processing.
